vectorize_single_example: vectorize a single reading comprehension example into torch tensors with word indices and features
vectorize_with_single_answer: vectorize an example with a single answer span using the single_answer flag
vectorize_without_answers: vectorize an inference example without answer targets and return only input tensors
batchify_vectorized_examples: batchify a list of vectorized examples into padded tensors for model training
batchify_with_targets: batchify vectorized examples with answer start and end span targets for supervised training
